addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - API usage, tool use, Anthropic SDK usage. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

- deep-research: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. - When the user wants a deep, multi-source, fact-checked research report on any topic. BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

# PRD Command

Produces a **Product Requirements Document** — the requirements-phase artifact of the SDLC. Captures *what* must be true for success and *why*, and stops before *how*. Implementation decomposition is delegated to `/plan`.

**Input**: ``

## Scope of this command

| This command does | This command does NOT do |
|---|---|
| Frame the problem and users | Design the architecture |
| Capture success criteria and scope | Pick files or write patterns |
| List open questions and risks | Enumerate implementation tasks |
| Write `.claude/prds/{name}.prd.md` | Produce an implementation plan — that's `/plan` |

If you find yourself writing implementation detail, stop and cut it. It belongs in `/plan`.

**Anti-fluff rule**: When information is missing, write `TBD — needs validation via {method}`. Never invent plausible-sounding requirements.

## Workflow

Four phases. Each phase is a single gate — ask the questions, wait for the user, then move on. No nested loops, no parallel research ceremony.

### Phase 1 — FRAME

If `` is empty, ask:

> What do you want to build? One or two sentences.

If provided, restate in one sentence and ask:

> I understand: *{restated}*. Correct, or should I adjust?

Then ask the framing questions in a single set:

> 1. **Who** has this problem? (specific role or segment)
> 2. **What** is the observable pain? (describe behavior, not assumed needs)
> 3. **Why** can't they solve it with what exists today?
> 4. **Why now?** — what changed that makes this worth doing?

Wait for the user. Do not proceed without answers (or explicit "skip").

### Phase 2 — GROUND

Ask for evidence. This is the shortest phase and the most load-bearing:

> What evidence do you have that this problem is real and worth solving? (user quotes, support tickets, metrics, observed behavior, failed workarounds — anything concrete)

If the user has none, record the PRD's Evidence section as `Assumption — needs validation via {user research | analytics | prototype}`. This keeps the PRD honest.

### Phase 3 — DECIDE

Scope and hypothesis in a single set:

> 1. **Hypothesis** — Complete: *We believe **{capability}** will **{solve problem}** for **{users}**. We'll know we're right when **{measurable outcome}**.*
> 2. **MVP** — The minimum needed to test the hypothesis?
> 3. **Out of scope** — What are you explicitly **not** building (even if users ask)?
> 4. **Open questions** — Uncertainties that could change the approach?

Wait for responses.

### Phase 4 — GENERATE & HAND OFF

Create the directory if needed, write the PRD, and report.

```bash
mkdir -p .claude/prds
```

**Output path**: `.claude/prds/{kebab-case-name}.prd.md`

#### PRD Template

```markdown
# {Product / Feature Name}

## Problem
{2–3 sentences: who has what problem, and what's the cost of leaving it unsolved?}

## Evidence
- {User quote, data point, or observation}
- {OR: "Assumption — needs validation via {method}"}

## Users
- **Primary**: {role, context, what triggers the need}
- **Not for**: {who this explicitly excludes}

## Hypothesis
We believe **{capability}** will **{solve problem}** for **{users}**.
We'll know we're right when **{measurable outcome}**.

## Success Metrics
| Metric | Target | How measured |
|---|---|---|
| {primary} | {number} | {method} |

## Scope
**MVP** — {the minimum to test the hypothesis}

**Out of scope**
- {item} — {why deferred}

## Delivery Milestones
<!-- Business outcomes, not engineering tasks. /plan turns each into a plan. -->
<!-- Status: pending | in-progress | complete -->

| # | Milestone | Outcome | Status | Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | {name} | {user-visible change} | pending | — |
| 2 | {name} | {user-visible change} | pending | — |

## Open Questions
- [ ] {question that could change scope or approach}

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|

*Status: DRAFT — requirements only. Implementation planning pending via /plan.*
```

#### Report to user

```
PRD created: .claude/prds/{name}.prd.md

Problem:    {one line}
Hypothesis: {one line}
MVP:        {one line}

Validation status:
  Problem  {validated | assumption}
  Users    {concrete | generic — refine}
  Metrics  {defined | TBD}

Open questions: {count}

Next step: /plan .claude/prds/{name}.prd.md
  → /plan will pick the next pending milestone and produce an implementation plan.
```

## Integration

- `/plan <prd-path>` — consume the PRD and produce an implementation plan for the next pending milestone.
- `tdd-workflow` skill — implement the plan test-first.
- `/pr` — open a PR that references the PRD and plan.

## Success criteria

- **PROBLEM_CLEAR**: problem is specific and evidenced (or flagged as assumption).
- **USER_CONCRETE**: primary user is a specific role, not "users".
- **HYPOTHESIS_TESTABLE**: measurable outcome included.
- **SCOPE_BOUNDED**: explicit MVP and explicit out-of-scope.
- **NO_IMPLEMENTATION_DETAIL**: file paths, libraries, or task breakdowns are absent — if they appeared, move them to the `/plan` step.

# 📋 Product Requirements Document (PRD)

## **Eterna** — AI-Powered Digital Afterlife & Inheritance Executor

---

## 1. Executive Summary

### 1.1 Product Vision
> *"Ketika kita tidak lagi ada, aset digital kita tetap terlindungi dan terdistribusi sesuai keinginan — tanpa birokrasi, tanpa notaris, tanpa kecurigaan."*

**Eterna** adalah AI Agent berbasis blockchain yang mengeksekusi wasiat digital secara otonom. Agent ini memantau "kehidupan" pemilik wallet melalui multi-layer trigger mechanism dan mendistribusikan aset ke beneficiary yang telah ditentukan — sepenuhnya tanpa intervensi manusia.

### 1.2 Problem Statement
| Problem | Current State | Impact |
|---------|-------------|--------|
| **$140B+ Bitcoin hilang** | Wallet owner meninggal tanpa menyampaikan private key | Aset digital tidak bisa diakses oleh keluarga |
| **Proses warisan tradisional lambat** | Notaris, pengadilan, birokrasi — bisa 6-24 bulan | Keluarga dalam kesulitan finansial menunggu |
| **Tidak ada trustless inheritance** | Harus percaya pihak ketiga (exchange, lawyer) | Risiko fraud, mismanagement, atau kebocoran data |
| **Crypto holder demographic muda** | Banyak holder usia 25-40 tidak punya estate planning | Risiko meningkat seiring adoption crypto |

### 1.3 Solution Overview
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         ETERNA FLOW                              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ┌──────────┐    ┌──────────┐    ┌──────────┐    ┌──────────┐  │
│  │  SETUP   │───▶│ MONITOR  │───▶│ TRIGGER  │───▶│ EXECUTE  │  │
│  │  Will    │    │  Life    │    │  Death   │    │  Estate  │  │
│  └──────────┘    └──────────┘    └──────────┘    └──────────┘  │
│       │               │               │               │         │
│       ▼               ▼               ▼               ▼         │
│   • Beneficiary   • Inactivity    • Multi-sig     • Auto      │
│   • Distribution  • Heartbeat     • Oracle        • Transfer   │
│   • Conditions    • Guardian      • Consensus     • Notify     │
│       │               │               │               │         │
│       └───────────────┴───────────────┴───────────────┘         │
│                         AI AGENT (ETERNA)                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Product Objectives & Success Metrics

### 2.1 Objectives
| No | Objective | Priority |
|----|-----------|----------|
| 1 | Memungkinkan user membuat wasiat digital yang terenkripsi dan immutable | P0 |
| 2 | Memantau "kehidupan" pemilik wallet melalui multi-layer trigger | P0 |
| 3 | Mengeksekusi distribusi aset secara otonom dan trustless | P0 |
| 4 | Memberikan transparency dan auditability penuh kepada beneficiary | P1 |
| 5 | Menyediakan UI/UX yang accessible untuk non-technical users | P1 |

### 2.2 Success Metrics (Hackathon Demo)
| Metric | Target |
|--------|--------|
| Demo execution time | < 3 menit end-to-end |
| Trigger mechanism | Minimum 2 layer (inactivity + guardian) |
| Asset types supported | ERC-20 tokens + ETH |
| UI intuitiveness | Judge bisa setup will tanpa guidance |

---

## 3. User Personas

### 3.1 Primary Persona: "Alex, The Crypto Native"
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  👤 Alex, 34 tahun                                           │
│  • Software engineer, crypto holder sejak 2017              │
│  • Portfolio: $250K (ETH, USDC, beberapa NFT)               │
│  • Single, orang tua di kampung halaman                     │
│  • Tidak punya will tradisional, khawatir jika sesuatu      │
│    terjadi padanya                                           │
│                                                              │
│  Pain Points:                                                │
│  • Tidak mau kasih private key ke siapapun sekarang         │
│  • Tidak percaya exchange atau pihak ketiga                 │
│  • Orang tuanya tidak paham crypto                          │
│  • Ingin kontrol penuh atas kapan dan bagaimana aset         │
│    didistribusikan                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 4. Core Features & Functionality

### 4.1 Feature List

#### **F1: Will Creation & Configuration** (P0)

|-------------|-------------|---------------------|
| F1.1 | Beneficiary Management | User bisa menambahkan 1+ beneficiary dengan alamat wallet/nama |
| F1.2 | Asset Distribution | User bisa set persentase/amount per beneficiary |
| F1.3 | Distribution Conditions | User bisa set conditions (e.g., "Sarah dapat 50% segera, 50% sisanya setelah 1 tahun") |
| F1.4 | Trigger Configuration | User pilih trigger mechanism (inactivity period, guardian consensus, oracle) |
| F1.5 | Will Encryption | Will data dienkripsi dan disimpan on-chain/IPFS |

#### **F2: Life Monitoring System** (P0)
| Sub-Feature | Description | Acceptance Criteria |
|-------------|-------------|---------------------|
| F2.1 | Heartbeat Mechanism | User bisa "check-in" secara berkala untuk menandakan "masih hidup" |
| F2.2 | Inactivity Detection | System memantau transaksi/activity wallet selama periode yang ditentukan |
| F2.3 | Guardian Network | 3-5 trusted guardians bisa "vote" untuk trigger execution |
| F2.4 | Oracle Integration | Integration dengan external data source (opsional untuk hackathon) |

#### **F3: Execution Engine** (P0)

| F3.2 | Asset Distribution | Auto-transfer sesuai konfigurasi will |
| F3.3 | Notification System | Kirim notifikasi ke beneficiary via email/SMS/on-chain message |
| F3.4 | Execution Log | Semua action tercatat on-chain untuk auditability |

#### **F4: Beneficiary Dashboard** (P1)
| Sub-Feature | Description | Acceptance Criteria |
|-------------|-------------|---------------------|
| F4.1 | Will Viewer | Beneficiary bisa melihat will (setelah trigger) |
| F4.2 | Claim Interface | Step-by-step guide untuk claim aset |
| F4.3 | Support Chat | AI chatbot untuk bantu beneficiary |

### 5.2 Smart Contract Architecture

```solidity
// ============================================
// ETERNA CORE CONTRACTS
// ============================================

// 1. EternaWill.sol — Core will storage & execution
contract EternaWill {
    struct Will {
        address owner;
        bytes32 encryptedDataHash;     // IPFS hash of encrypted will
        uint256 inactivityThreshold;   // e.g., 180 days
        uint256 lastActivity;          // timestamp of last heartbeat
        address[] beneficiaries;
        uint256[] percentages;
        bool isExecuted;
        Guardian[] guardians;
    }
    
    struct Guardian {
        address guardianAddress;
        bool hasVoted;
        bool vote;
    }
    
    // Trigger mechanisms
    function checkIn() external;                    // Heartbeat
    function guardianVote(bool _isDeceased) external;
    function executeWill() external;                // AI Agent calls this
}

// 2. EternaGuardian.sol — Guardian management
contract EternaGuardian {
    function addGuardian(address _will, address _guardian) external;
    function removeGuardian(address _will, address _guardian) external;
    function getGuardianStatus(address _will) external view returns (uint256 votesFor, uint256 total);
}

// 3. EternaDistribution.sol — Asset distribution logic
contract EternaDistribution {
    function distributeAssets(
        address _will,
        address[] calldata _beneficiaries,
        uint256[] calldata _percentages
    ) external;
    
    function distributeWithConditions(
        address _will,
        Condition[] calldata _conditions
    ) external;
}
```

## 9. Security & Privacy

### 9.1 Security Measures

| Layer | Measure | Implementation |
|-------|---------|----------------|
| **Data Encryption** | Will data encrypted before IPFS storage | AES-256 + owner public key |
| **Access Control** | Only owner can modify will | Smart contract ownership |
| **Execution Safety** | Multi-layer trigger prevents false execution | Confidence scoring (≥0.7) |
| **Guardian Integrity** | Guardians cannot collude easily | Minimum 3 guardians, threshold 2/3 |
| **Audit Trail** | All actions logged on-chain | ExecutionLog contract |
| **Emergency Stop** | Owner can pause/cancel will | Pause mechanism in contract |

### 9.2 Privacy Considerations

- Will content (beneficiary details, amounts) dienkripsi — hanya hash yang on-chain
- Beneficiary identity tidak terexpos sampai execution
- Guardian tidak tahu isi will, hanya bisa vote "deceased" atau not

# 📋 Product Requirements Document (PRD)

## **Eterna** — AI-Powered Digital Afterlife & Inheritance Executor

---

## 1. Executive Summary

### 1.1 Product Vision
> *"Ketika kita tidak lagi ada, aset digital kita tetap terlindungi dan terdistribusi sesuai keinginan — tanpa birokrasi, tanpa notaris, tanpa kecurigaan."*

**Eterna** adalah AI Agent berbasis blockchain yang mengeksekusi wasiat digital secara otonom. Agent ini memantau "kehidupan" pemilik wallet melalui multi-layer trigger mechanism dan mendistribusikan aset ke beneficiary yang telah ditentukan — sepenuhnya tanpa intervensi manusia.

### 1.2 Problem Statement

|---------|-------------|--------|
| **$140B+ Bitcoin hilang** | Wallet owner meninggal tanpa menyampaikan private key | Aset digital tidak bisa diakses oleh keluarga |
| **Proses warisan tradisional lambat** | Notaris, pengadilan, birokrasi — bisa 6-24 bulan | Keluarga dalam kesulitan finansial menunggu |
| **Tidak ada trustless inheritance** | Harus percaya pihak ketiga (exchange, lawyer) | Risiko fraud, mismanagement, atau kebocoran data |
| **Crypto holder demographic muda** | Banyak holder usia 25-40 tidak punya estate planning | Risiko meningkat seiring adoption crypto |

### 5.2 Smart Contract Architecture

```solidity
// ============================================
// ETERNA CORE CONTRACTS
// ============================================

// 1. EternaWill.sol — Core will storage & execution
contract EternaWill {
    struct Will {
        address owner;
        bytes32 encryptedDataHash;     // IPFS hash of encrypted will
        uint256 inactivityThreshold;   // e.g., 180 days
        uint256 lastActivity;          // timestamp of last heartbeat
        address[] beneficiaries;
        uint256[] percentages;
        bool isExecuted;
        Guardian[] guardians;
    }
    
    struct Guardian {
        address guardianAddress;
        bool hasVoted;
        bool vote;
    }
    
    // Trigger mechanisms
    function checkIn() external;                    // Heartbeat
    function guardianVote(bool _isDeceased) external;
    function executeWill() external;                // AI Agent calls this
}

// 2. EternaGuardian.sol — Guardian management
contract EternaGuardian {
    function addGuardian(address _will, address _guardian) external;
    function removeGuardian(address _will, address _guardian) external;
    function getGuardianStatus(address _will) external view returns (uint256 votesFor, uint256 total);
}

// 3. EternaDistribution.sol — Asset distribution logic
contract EternaDistribution {
    function distributeAssets(
        address _will,
        address[] calldata _beneficiaries,
        uint256[] calldata _percentages
    ) external;
    
    function distributeWithConditions(
        address _will,
        Condition[] calldata _conditions
    ) external;
}
```

## 9. Security & Privacy

### 9.1 Security Measures

| Layer | Measure | Implementation |
|-------|---------|----------------|
| **Data Encryption** | Will data encrypted before IPFS storage | AES-256 + owner public key |
| **Access Control** | Only owner can modify will | Smart contract ownership |
| **Execution Safety** | Multi-layer trigger prevents false execution | Confidence scoring (≥0.7) |
| **Guardian Integrity** | Guardians cannot collude easily | Minimum 3 guardians, threshold 2/3 |
| **Audit Trail** | All actions logged on-chain | ExecutionLog contract |
| **Emergency Stop** | Owner can pause/cancel will | Pause mechanism in contract |

### 9.2 Privacy Considerations

- Will content (beneficiary details, amounts) dienkripsi — hanya hash yang on-chain
- Beneficiary identity tidak terexpos sampai execution
- Guardian tidak tahu isi will, hanya bisa vote "deceased" atau not

# Eterna — AI-Powered Digital Afterlife & Inheritance Executor

## Problem
Over **$140B in Bitcoin** is estimated lost forever because wallet owners passed away without sharing private keys. Current inheritance processes rely on slow bureaucratic systems (notaries, courts, lawyers — 6-24 months) and require trusting third parties (exchanges, legal firms) with sensitive financial data. Meanwhile, the crypto demographic skews young (25-40) with minimal estate planning — a growing risk as adoption accelerates. Keluarga tidak bisa mengakses aset digital anggota keluarganya yang meninggal, menyebabkan kesulitan finansial di saat paling dibutuhkan.

## Evidence
- **$140B+ Bitcoin** diperkirakan hilang permanen karena pemilik meninggal tanpa menyampaikan akses wallet
- **Proses warisan tradisional** memakan 6-24 bulan dengan biaya notaris dan pengadilan
- **Tidak ada solusi trustless** — semua solusi existing mengharuskan percaya pihak ketiga (exchange, lawyer, kustodian)
- **Crypto holder demographic** — banyak usia 25-40 tahun tanpa estate planning
- **User behavior**: "Saya tidak mau kasih private key ke siapapun sekarang" — kebutuhan akan delayed-trigger inheritance

## Users
- **Primary**: **Alex, Crypto Native (34)** — Software engineer, crypto holder sejak 2017, portfolio $250K+. Ingin memastikan aset digitalnya diwariskan ke orang tua yang tidak paham crypto, tanpa memberikan private key ke siapapun selama hidupnya.
- **Secondary**: **Sarah, Beneficiary (60)** — Orang tua yang tidak paham teknologi. Butuh notifikasi sederhana dan step-by-step guide untuk claim aset.
- **Not for**: Exchange/wallet providers yang ingin hold aset pengguna; inheritance untuk aset non-digital (tanah, properti fisik).

## Hypothesis
Kami percaya **AI Agent dengan multi-layer trigger mechanism** akan **memungkinkan crypto holders mengeksekusi wasiat digital secara trustless dan otonom** untuk **pemilik wallet crypto yang khawatir dengan nasib aset mereka setelah meninggal**.
Kami akan tahu kami benar ketika **user bisa setup wasiat digital dalam <5 menit dan AI Agent berhasil mengeksekusi distribusi aset secara otonom tanpa intervensi manusia dalam demo hackathon**.

## Success Metrics
| Metric | Target | How measured |
|---|---|---|
| Demo execution time (end-to-end) | < 3 menit | Stopwatch demo |
| Trigger mechanisms implemented | ≥ 2 layer | Code review (inactivity + guardian) |
| Asset types supported | ERC-20 tokens + ETH | Functional test |
| UI intuitiveness | Judge bisa setup will tanpa guidance | Demo observation |
| Will creation time | < 5 menit | UX measurement |
| Execution accuracy | 100% sesuai konfigurasi will | On-chain verification |

## Scope
**MVP** — Sebuah web app MVP yang memungkinkan:
1. User connect wallet dan membuat wasiat digital dengan beneficiary + persentase
2. Multi-layer trigger mechanism (inactivity period + guardian consensus)
3. AI Agent yang memonitor trigger dan mengeksekusi distribusi aset
4. Beneficiary notification via email
5. Full demo flow di Base Sepolia testnet

**Out of scope**
- Legal enforcement / notaris integration — kompleksitas hukum di luar scope hackathon
- NFT inheritance — fokus ke ERC-20 dan ETH dulu
- Mobile app — web-only untuk MVP
- Multi-chain support — satu chain (EVM) untuk MVP
- Fiat on-ramp/off-ramp — tidak relevan untuk demo
- Regulatory compliance penuh — akan dibahas di fase post-hackathon

## Delivery Milestones
<!-- Business outcomes, not engineering tasks. /plan turns each into a plan. -->
<!-- Status: pending | in-progress | complete -->

| # | Milestone | Outcome | Status | Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Smart Contract Development | Will creation, guardian voting, distribution logic on-chain | pending | — |
| 2 | Backend + AI Agent Engine | Trigger monitoring, execution validator, notification service | pending | — |
| 3 | Frontend: Will Builder UI | User dapat setup will, add beneficiaries, configure triggers | pending | — |
| 4 | Frontend: Beneficiary Portal | Beneficiary dapat view will dan claim assets | pending | — |
| 5 | Integration & Demo Polish | End-to-end flow working, demo script ready | pending | — |

## Open Questions
- [ ] Bagaimana handling gas fee untuk eksekusi? Dari owner wallet atau dari contract?
- [ ] Apa mekanisme recovery jika beneficiary kehilangan akses wallet-nya?
- [ ] Validitas legal: apakah AI Agent execution bisa diterima secara hukum?
- [ ] Bagaimana handling jika nilai aset tidak cukup untuk cover gas fee saat eksekusi?
- [ ] Apakah perlu time-lock mechanism untuk mencegah eksekusi premature?

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| False execution (salah trigger) | Low | Critical | Multi-layer trigger + confidence threshold ≥ 0.7 |
| Smart contract bug | Medium | High | Test coverage + audit post-hackathon |
| Guardian collusion | Low | High | Minimum 3 guardians, max threshold 2/3 |
| User tidak定期 heartbeat | Medium | Medium | Multiple reminders + grace period |
| Beneficiary tidak bisa claim | Medium | Medium | Email notification + support chat + extended deadline |
| Regulatory uncertainty | Medium | Medium | Konsultasi legal di fase post-hackathon |

*Status: DRAFT — requirements only. Implementation planning pending via /plan.*

---

**Detail Teknis Tambahan:**

### Tech Stack (Hackathon)
| Layer | Technology | Alasan |
|---|---|---|
| Frontend | Next.js + TailwindCSS + RainbowKit | Cepat, UX bagus, wallet integration mudah |
| Smart Contracts | Solidity + Hardhat | EVM, familiar untuk judges |
| Blockchain | Base Sepolia / Sepolia | Testnet gratis, finality cepat |
| Storage | IPFS (Pinata) | Decentralized, free tier available |
| AI/Backend | Node.js + OpenAI/Claude API | Quick setup, LLM untuk AI Agent logic |
| Notifications | SendGrid (email) | Free tier, reliable |

### Demo Flow (3 menit)
1. **0:00-0:30** — Hook: "$140B crypto lost forever"
2. **0:30-1:00** — Alex setup will (connect → add beneficiaries → set % → configure triggers)
3. **1:00-1:30** — Simulasi inactivity (dashboard shows "no heartbeat for 6 months")
4. **1:30-2:00** — Guardian vote (2/3 vote "deceased" → AI confidence score: 0.85)
5. **2:00-2:30** — AI Agent executes → assets distributed on-chain
6. **2:30-3:00** — Sarah receives email → claim portal → sees her allocation

# Eterna — AI-Powered Digital Afterlife & Inheritance Executor

## Problem
Over **$140B in Bitcoin** is estimated lost forever because wallet owners passed away without sharing private keys. Current inheritance processes rely on slow bureaucratic systems (notaries, courts, lawyers — 6-24 months) and require trusting third parties (exchanges, legal firms) with sensitive financial data. Meanwhile, the crypto demographic skews young (25-40) with minimal estate planning — a growing risk as adoption accelerates. Keluarga tidak bisa mengakses aset digital anggota keluarganya yang meninggal, menyebabkan kesulitan finansial di saat paling dibutuhkan.

## Evidence
- **$140B+ Bitcoin** diperkirakan hilang permanen karena pemilik meninggal tanpa menyampaikan akses wallet
- **Proses warisan tradisional** memakan 6-24 bulan dengan biaya notaris dan pengadilan
- **Tidak ada solusi trustless** — semua solusi existing mengharuskan percaya pihak ketiga (exchange, lawyer, kustodian)
- **Crypto holder demographic** — banyak usia 25-40 tahun tanpa estate planning
- **User behavior**: "Saya tidak mau kasih private key ke siapapun sekarang" — kebutuhan akan delayed-trigger inheritance

## Users
- **Primary**: **Alex, Crypto Native (34)** — Software engineer, crypto holder sejak 2017, portfolio $250K+. Ingin memastikan aset digitalnya diwariskan ke orang tua yang tidak paham crypto, tanpa memberikan private key ke siapapun selama hidupnya.
- **Secondary**: **Sarah, Beneficiary (60)** — Orang tua yang tidak paham teknologi. Butuh notifikasi sederhana dan step-by-step guide untuk claim aset.
- **Not for**: Exchange/wallet providers yang ingin hold aset pengguna; inheritance untuk aset non-digital (tanah, properti fisik).

## Hypothesis
Kami percaya **AI Agent dengan multi-layer trigger mechanism** akan **memungkinkan crypto holders mengeksekusi wasiat digital secara trustless dan otonom** untuk **pemilik wallet crypto yang khawatir dengan nasib aset mereka setelah meninggal**.
Kami akan tahu kami benar ketika **user bisa setup wasiat digital dalam <5 menit dan AI Agent berhasil mengeksekusi distribusi aset secara otonom tanpa intervensi manusia dalam demo hackathon**.

## Success Metrics
| Metric | Target | How measured |
|---|---|---|
| Demo execution time (end-to-end) | < 3 menit | Stopwatch demo |
| Trigger mechanisms implemented | ≥ 2 layer | Code review (inactivity + guardian) |
| Asset types supported | ERC-20 tokens + ETH | Functional test |
| UI intuitiveness | Judge bisa setup will tanpa guidance | Demo observation |
| Will creation time | < 5 menit | UX measurement |
| Execution accuracy | 100% sesuai konfigurasi will | On-chain verification |

## Scope
**MVP** — Sebuah web app MVP yang memungkinkan:
1. User connect wallet dan membuat wasiat digital dengan beneficiary + persentase
2. Multi-layer trigger mechanism (inactivity period + guardian consensus)
3. AI Agent yang memonitor trigger dan mengeksekusi distribusi aset
4. Beneficiary notification via email
5. Full demo flow di Base Sepolia testnet

**Out of scope**
- Legal enforcement / notaris integration — kompleksitas hukum di luar scope hackathon
- NFT inheritance — fokus ke ERC-20 dan ETH dulu
- Mobile app — web-only untuk MVP
- Multi-chain support — satu chain (EVM) untuk MVP
- Fiat on-ramp/off-ramp — tidak relevan untuk demo
- Regulatory compliance penuh — akan dibahas di fase post-hackathon

## Delivery Milestones
<!-- Business outcomes, not engineering tasks. /plan turns each into a plan. -->
<!-- Status: pending | in-progress | complete -->

| # | Milestone | Outcome | Status | Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Smart Contract Development | Will creation, guardian voting, distribution logic on-chain | pending | — |
| 2 | Backend + AI Agent Engine | Trigger monitoring, execution validator, notification service | pending | — |
| 3 | Frontend: Will Builder UI | User dapat setup will, add beneficiaries, configure triggers | pending | — |
| 4 | Frontend: Beneficiary Portal | Beneficiary dapat view will dan claim assets | pending | — |
| 5 | Integration & Demo Polish | End-to-end flow working, demo script ready | pending | — |

## Open Questions
- [ ] Bagaimana handling gas fee untuk eksekusi? Dari owner wallet atau dari contract?
- [ ] Apa mekanisme recovery jika beneficiary kehilangan akses wallet-nya?
- [ ] Validitas legal: apakah AI Agent execution bisa diterima secara hukum?
- [ ] Bagaimana handling jika nilai aset tidak cukup untuk cover gas fee saat eksekusi?
- [ ] Apakah perlu time-lock mechanism untuk mencegah eksekusi premature?

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| False execution (salah trigger) | Low | Critical | Multi-layer trigger + confidence threshold ≥ 0.7 |
| Smart contract bug | Medium | High | Test coverage + audit post-hackathon |
| Guardian collusion | Low | High | Minimum 3 guardians, max threshold 2/3 |
| User tidak定期 heartbeat | Medium | Medium | Multiple reminders + grace period |
| Beneficiary tidak bisa claim | Medium | Medium | Email notification + support chat + extended deadline |
| Regulatory uncertainty | Medium | Medium | Konsultasi legal di fase post-hackathon |

*Status: DRAFT — requirements only. Implementation planning pending via /plan.*

**Detail Teknis Tambahan:**

### Tech Stack (Hackathon)
| Layer | Technology | Alasan |

| Frontend | Next.js + TailwindCSS + RainbowKit | Cepat, UX bagus, wallet integration mudah |
| Smart Contracts | Solidity + Hardhat | EVM, familiar untuk judges |
| Blockchain | Base Sepolia / Sepolia | Testnet gratis, finality cepat |
| Storage | IPFS (Pinata) | Decentralized, free tier available |
| AI/Backend | Node.js + OpenAI/Claude API | Quick setup, LLM untuk AI Agent logic |
| Notifications | SendGrid (email) | Free tier, reliable |

### Demo Flow (3 menit)
1. **0:00-0:30** — Hook: "$140B crypto lost forever"
2. **0:30-1:00** — Alex setup will (connect → add beneficiaries → set % → configure triggers)
3. **1:00-1:30** — Simulasi inactivity (dashboard shows "no heartbeat for 6 months")
4. **1:30-2:00** — Guardian vote (2/3 vote "deceased" → AI confidence score: 0.85)
5. **2:00-2:30** — AI Agent executes → assets distributed on-chain
6. **2:30-3:00** — Sarah receives email → claim portal → sees her allocation

# 📋 Implementation Plan: Eterna — AI Digital Afterlife

---

## Requirements Restatement

Membangun **Eterna**, sebuah platform web yang memungkinkan:
1. **Crypto holder** membuat wasiat digital on-chain dengan beneficiary, persentase, dan trigger configuration
2. **Multi-layer trigger mechanism**: inactivity detection + guardian consensus
3. **AI Agent** yang memonitor trigger dan secara otonom mengeksekusi distribusi aset
4. **Beneficiary notification & claim portal** untuk non-technical users

Target: **Demo 3 menit di Base Sepolia testnet untuk hackathon.**

---

## Implementation Phases

### Phase 0: Project Scaffolding & Dev Environment
| Step | Task | Detail |
|------|------|--------|
| 0.1 | Init monorepo | Next.js (frontend) + Hardhat (contracts) + Node.js (backend) dalam satu repo |
| 0.2 | Setup Hardhat | Konfigurasi Solidity, Base Sepolia network, deploy scripts |
| 0.3 | Setup Frontend | Next.js + TailwindCSS + RainbowKit + TypeScript |
| 0.4 | Setup Backend | Node.js + Express + ethers.js + cron/scheduler |
| 0.5 | Environment config | .env template (RPC URL, private keys, API keys) |

### Phase 1: Smart Contracts (Solidity + Hardhat)
| Step | Task | Detail |
|------|------|--------|
| 1.1 | `EternaWill.sol` | Struct: Will, Beneficiary, Guardian. Functions: createWill, updateWill, checkIn, getWillStatus |
| 1.2 | Guardian logic | addGuardian, removeGuardian, vote (yes/no), getVoteStatus |
| 1.3 | Trigger validation | isExecutable() — checks inactivity, guardian consensus, execution flag |
| 1.4 | Distribution logic | distributeAssets() — batch transfer ERC-20 + ETH ke beneficiaries |
| 1.5 | Events & modifiers | event WillCreated, WillExecuted, Heartbeat, GuardianVoted. Modifier: onlyOwner, notExecuted |
| 1.6 | Unit tests | test coverage untuk create, vote, execute edge cases |
| 1.7 | Deploy script | Deploy ke Base Sepolia + verify di explorer |

### Phase 2: Backend — AI Agent Engine (Node.js)
| Step | Task | Detail |
|------|------|--------|
| 2.1 | Trigger Monitor | Cron job tiap N menit: scan all active wills, check inactivity |
| 2.2 | AI Agent Core | Calculate confidence score dari inactivity + guardian votes + oracle |
| 2.3 | Execution Engine | Jika confidence >= threshold → call executeWill() + record execution log |
| 2.4 | Notification Service | SendGrid integration: email ke beneficiary saat will ter-execute |
| 2.5 | API Layer | Express routes: GET /wills, POST /heartbeat, GET /execution-status |
| 2.6 | IPFS Integration | Pinata client: upload encrypted will data, store hash on-chain |

### Phase 3: Frontend — Will Builder & Dashboard (Next.js)
| Step | Task | Detail |
|------|------|--------|
| 3.1 | Wallet Connection | RainbowKit integration (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase) |
| 3.2 | Will Creation Wizard | Step-by-step: add beneficiaries → set % → triggers → review → sign |
| 3.3 | Dashboard | My Will status, last heartbeat, beneficiary list, trigger status |
| 3.4 | Guardian Panel | Accept/reject guardian invitation, vote interface |
| 3.5 | Heartbeat Button | One-click checkIn transaction |
| 3.6 | Will Management | Edit/cancel will (owner only) |

### Phase 4: Frontend — Beneficiary Portal
| Step | Task | Detail |
|------|------|--------|
| 4.1 | Beneficiary Auth | Email token / magic link untuk akses portal |
| 4.2 | Will Viewer | Menampilkan will detail (setelah trigger) |
| 4.3 | Claim Interface | Step-by-step: connect wallet → verify identity → claim assets |
| 4.4 | Claim History | Status: pending → claimed → completed |

### Phase 5: Integration, Testing & Demo Polish
| Step | Task | Detail |
|------|------|--------|
| 5.1 | E2E Integration | Frontend ↔ Backend ↔ Smart Contracts: full flow test |
| 5.2 | Demo Script | Seed data: pre-made will, guardian accounts, test ETH |
| 5.3 | UI Polish | Loading states, error handling, responsive design, animations |
| 5.4 | Presentation Deck | 3-min demo script + slide deck untuk judges |
| 5.5 | Deploy All | Smart contract di Base Sepolia, frontend di Vercel, backend di Railway/Render |

---

## Dependencies

| Dependency | Version | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Node.js | ≥ 18 | Runtime |
| Hardhat | ^2.20 | Smart contract development |
| Solidity | ^0.8.24 | Smart contract language |
| OpenZeppelin | ^5.0 | Secure contract primitives (Ownable, ReentrancyGuard) |
| Next.js | ^14 | Frontend framework |
| RainbowKit | ^2 | Wallet connection UI |
| wagmi | ^2 | React hooks for Ethereum |
| ethers.js | ^6 | Blockchain interaction |
| TailwindCSS | ^3 | CSS framework |
| Pinata SDK | ^2 | IPFS upload |
| SendGrid / Resend | — | Email notification |
| node-cron | ^3 | Scheduler for AI Agent |

---

## Risks

| Level | Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| **🔥 HIGH** | Smart contract bug causes loss of funds | Extensive unit tests + testnet-only untuk MVP |
| **🔥 HIGH** | AI Agent false-positive execution | Confidence threshold ≥ 0.7, multi-layer trigger |
| **⚠️ MEDIUM** | Gas fee untuk eksekusi habis | Pre-fund contract with test ETH, atau user funds execution |
| **⚠️ MEDIUM** | Beneficiary tidak punya wallet | Guide untuk buat wallet, atau claim-to-email (future) |
| **⚠️ MEDIUM** | SendGrid API rate limit | Queue system + retry logic |
| **✅ LOW** | IPFS pinning failure | Retry mechanism + fallback storage |
| **✅ LOW** | Demo network congestion | Deploy early, test multiple times |

---

## Estimated Complexity & Timeline

| Phase | Complexity | Estimated Time (Hackathon) |
|---|---|---|
| Phase 0: Scaffolding | LOW | 30 min |
| Phase 1: Smart Contracts | **HIGH** | 4-5 jam |
| Phase 2: Backend + AI Agent | MEDIUM | 3-4 jam |
| Phase 3: Frontend Will Builder | MEDIUM | 4-5 jam |
| Phase 4: Beneficiary Portal | LOW | 1-2 jam |
| Phase 5: Integration & Polish | MEDIUM | 2-3 jam |
| **Total** | | **~16-22 jam (2-3 hari)** |

---

**⏳ WAITING FOR CONFIRMATION**: Proceed with this implementation plan?

- ✅ **Yes / Proceed** — Saya mulai implementasi Phase 0 → Phase 1
- 🔧 **Modify** — Adjust scope, priorities, atau approach
- ❌ **No** — Cancel atau restructure

Silakan konfirmasi!

# 🕊️ Eterna — AI-Powered Digital Afterlife & Inheritance Executor

> *"When we no longer exist, our digital assets remain protected and distributed according to our wishes — trustlessly, transparently, automatically."*

## The Problem

Over **$140B in Bitcoin** is estimated lost forever because wallet owners passed away without sharing private keys. Current inheritance processes rely on slow bureaucratic systems (6-24 months with notaries, courts, lawyers) and require trusting third parties with sensitive financial data.

## The Solution

**Eterna** uses an AI Agent + Smart Contracts to create a trustless digital inheritance system:

### How It Works

1. **Create Your Will** — Connect wallet, add beneficiaries, set percentages, configure triggers
2. **AI Agent Monitors** — Tracks heartbeat, guardian votes, and inactivity periods
3. **Auto Distribution** — When triggers are met, AI executes the will and distributes assets

## 🏗️ Architecture

```
eterna/
├── contracts/        # Solidity + Hardhat
│   ├── contracts/    # Smart contracts
│   ├── test/         # Contract tests
│   └── scripts/      # Deploy & seed scripts
├── frontend/         # Next.js + RainbowKit
│   └── src/
│       └── app/
│           ├── create/       # Will creation wizard
│           ├── dashboard/    # User dashboard
│           ├── will/[id]/    # Will details
│           ├── guardian/[id] # Guardian voting portal
│           └── claim/[id]    # Beneficiary claim portal
├── backend/          # Node.js + Express
│   └── src/
│       ├── agent.ts         # AI Agent engine
│       ├── contract.ts      # Blockchain interactions
│       ├── notifications.ts # Email notifications
│       └── api.ts           # REST API
└── scripts/          # Demo & utility scripts
```

## ✨ Features

| Feature | Status | Description |
|---------|--------|-------------|
| Will Creation | ✅ | Multi-step wizard with beneficiary management |
| Heartbeat Mechanism | ✅ | Regular check-ins to prove life |
| Guardian Network | ✅ | Trusted parties vote to confirm death |
| Multi-Layer Triggers | ✅ | Inactivity + Guardian consensus |
| Confidence Scoring | ✅ | AI calculates combined confidence (70% threshold) |
| Asset Distribution | ✅ | ETH & ERC-20 auto-distribution |
| Beneficiary Portal | ✅ | Claim interface for non-technical users |
| Email Notifications | ✅ | Automated beneficiary alerts |
| AI Execution Log | ✅ | LLM-generated execution summaries |

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| **Frontend** | Next.js 16 + TailwindCSS + RainbowKit |
| **Smart Contracts** | Solidity 0.8.24 + Hardhat |
| **Blockchain** | Base Sepolia / Ethereum Sepolia |
| **Backend** | Node.js + Express + ethers.js |
| **AI** | OpenAI API / Claude API |
| **Storage** | IPFS (Pinata) |
| **Notifications** | SendGrid |

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

- Node.js ≥ 18
- npm

### 1. Smart Contracts

```bash
cd contracts
npm install
cp .env.example .env  # Add your PRIVATE_KEY
npx hardhat compile
npx hardhat test                    # Run tests
npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network baseSepolia  # Deploy
```

### 2. Backend

```bash
cd backend
npm install
cp .env.example .env  # Add contract address, RPC URL, etc.
npm run dev
```

### 3. Frontend

```bash
cd frontend
npm install
cp .env.example .env.local  # Set NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS
npm run dev
```

### 4. Demo Seed

```bash
cd contracts
npx hardhat run scripts/seed.ts --network hardhat
```

## 🎯 3-Minute Demo Script

| Time | Action |
|------|--------|
| 0:00-0:30 | Hook: "$140B crypto lost forever — Eterna fixes this" |
| 0:30-1:00 | Alex connects wallet → creates will with Sarah & Mike |
| 1:00-1:30 | Show dashboard: inactivity detected, guardians voting |
| 1:30-2:00 | Guardians vote "deceased" → AI confidencescore: 85% |
| 2:00-2:30 | AI Agent executes → assets distributed on-chain |
| 2:30-3:00 | Sarah receives email → claim portal → allocation shown |

## 🧪 Test Results

```
17 passing (1s)
  ✓ Will Creation (4 tests)
  ✓ Heartbeat (3 tests)
  ✓ Guardian Voting (3 tests)
  ✓ Execution (4 tests)
  ✓ Will Management (3 tests)
```

## 📋 Smart Contract API

### Core Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `createWill(...)` | Create a new digital will |
| `checkIn(willId)` | Send heartbeat |
| `guardianVote(willId, bool)` | Vote on owner status |
| `checkExecutable(willId)` | Check if triggers are met |
| `executeWill(willId)` | Execute will (AI Agent) |
| `distributeETH(willId)` | Distribute ETH |
| `distributeERC20(willId, token)` | Distribute ERC-20 |
| `revokeWill(willId)` | Revoke will (owner only) |

### View Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `getWill(willId)` | Get will details |
| `getBeneficiaries(willId)` | List beneficiaries |
| `getGuardians(willId)` | List guardians |
| `getWillStatus(willId)` | Get confidence scores |
| `getOwnerWills(owner)` | Get user's wills |
| `isGuardian(willId, addr)` | Check guardian status |

## 🔒 Security

- **Multi-layer triggers** prevent false execution
- **70% confidence threshold** required for execution
- **Guardian consensus** — minimum 2/3 vote required
- **Encrypted will data** — only hash stored on-chain
- **Owner-only controls** — modify or revoke at any time

## 👥 Team (Hackathon)

| Role | Responsibilities |
|------|------------------|
| **Smart Contract Dev** | Solidity contracts, deployment, testing |
| **Frontend Dev** | Next.js UI, wallet integration |
| **AI/Backend Dev** | Trigger monitor, execution engine, API |
| **Designer** | UI/UX, demo presentation |

## 📄 License

MIT — Built for hackathon purposes.

| 1:00-1:30 | Show dashboard: inactivity detected, guardians voting |
| 1:30-2:00 | Guardians vote "deceased" → AI confidencescore: 85% |
| 2:00-2:30 | AI Agent executes → assets distributed on-chain |
| 2:30-3:00 | Sarah receives email → claim portal → allocation shown |

## 🧪 Test Results

```
17 passing (1s)
  ✓ Will Creation (4 tests)
  ✓ Heartbeat (3 tests)
  ✓ Guardian Voting (3 tests)
  ✓ Execution (4 tests)
  ✓ Will Management (3 tests)
```

## 📋 Smart Contract API

### Core Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `createWill(...)` | Create a new digital will |
| `checkIn(willId)` | Send heartbeat |
| `guardianVote(willId, bool)` | Vote on owner status |
| `checkExecutable(willId)` | Check if triggers are met |
| `executeWill(willId)` | Execute will (AI Agent) |
| `distributeETH(willId)` | Distribute ETH |
| `distributeERC20(willId, token)` | Distribute ERC-20 |
| `revokeWill(willId)` | Revoke will (owner only) |

### View Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `getWill(willId)` | Get will details |
| `getBeneficiaries(willId)` | List beneficiaries |
| `getGuardians(willId)` | List guardians |
| `getWillStatus(willId)` | Get confidence scores |
| `getOwnerWills(owner)` | Get user's wills |
| `isGuardian(willId, addr)` | Check guardian status |

## 🔒 Security

- **Multi-layer triggers** prevent false execution
- **70% confidence threshold** required for execution
- **Guardian consensus** — minimum 2/3 vote required
- **Encrypted will data** — only hash stored on-chain
- **Owner-only controls** — modify or revoke at any time

| Role | Responsibilities |
|------|------------------|
| **Smart Contract Dev** | Solidity contracts, deployment, testing |
| **Frontend Dev** | Next.js UI, wallet integration |
| **AI/Backend Dev** | Trigger monitor, execution engine, API |
| **Designer** | UI/UX, demo presentation |
